title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; parity fixes; v1.75.0
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) had diverging behaviors around auth token refresh, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming event shapes which produced maintenance overhead and developer confusion. This PR unifies: 1) auth credential loading and transparent token refresh across all SDKs; 2) retry policy defaults and how transient vs permanent errors are classified; 3) streaming API ergonomics so all languages expose a consistent event model and iteration patterns. Changes include API surface adjustments for ergonomics (non-breaking in most cases), parity fixes where features existed in one SDK but not others, and coordinated version bumps to v1.75.0. Checklist: - Implement unified auth layer and token refresh strategy across SDKs - Standardize retry/backoff defaults and expose configuration knobs - Harmonize streaming event envelope and async iterators - Add compatibility shims and deprecation warnings where necessary - Update unit/integration tests and add cross-language e2e harness - Update changelogs and bump versions to v1.75.0 Summary of work: Python: new redwood_sdk.auth.AuthSession class that centralizes credential providers (env/credentials file/KMS integration) and automatic refresh; simplified public client constructor to accept AuthSession or legacy token with deprecation warning; retry policy extracted to redwood_sdk.retries with exponential backoff and jitter and clear classification of 429/5xx vs 4xx permanent failures; streaming changes to yield typed events and a simplified async iterator pattern that matches TypeScript/Go ergonomics. TypeScript: new AuthSession and exported types for RetryPolicy; streaming client now exposes a for-await-of friendly stream() returning unified event types with typed helpers; improved docs and examples. Go: added AuthSession equivalent (auth.Session) and RetryPolicy struct, streaming client now returns a channel of unified StreamEvent structs and a convenience iterator wrapper. Parity fixes: batching, metadata headers, and n-best reformatting had minor API differences; these are fixed and tests added. Versioning: bump to v1.75.0 across SDKs with migration notes included in changelogs. Testing: unit + integration suites updated, cross-language e2e runs in CI verified compatibility against the local redwood API fixture. Migration notes: existing code using legacy token constructor will continue to work but will emit a deprecation warning; we provide a small migration snippet in each SDK's CHANGELOG. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes for common patterns, but advanced custom retry implementations may need small adjustments; see CHANGELOG entry.
commits: feat(python): add AuthSession and centralize credential providers
fix(python): standardize retry classification and add jitter
feat(ts): add AuthSession and RetryPolicy types, streaming ergonomics
feat(go): auth.Session and StreamEvent channel + iterator wrapper
chore(sdk): bump versions to v1.75.0 and update changelogs
test: add cross-language e2e harness and fixtures
review_thread: Samir: Nice consolidation, can you confirm token refresh happens transparently even during streaming?
Elena: Yes 	6 Python/TS/Go all refresh on 401 during an active stream and resume without dropping the stream; added tests to cover this path.
Marta: Retry defaults look sensible but can we expose max attempts and base/backoff as a config object?
Elena: Done, RetryPolicy now accepts maxAttempts/base/backoff/jitterFactor and defaults keep previous effective behavior.
Kenji: Go stream channel looks fine but please ensure zero allocations in hot path; consider pooling.
Elena: Addressed 	6 added a small object pool for StreamEvent reuse behind build flag for high-throughput builds.
Samir: CI flaky on ts lint earlier, saw an unrelated formatting error.
Elena: Fixed formatting and added a Prettier config to avoid regressions.
